name: F3X Workspace
desc:
Welcome to F3X Workspace! This is a game where you can build with F3X tools (b-tools) and have fun! There is HD admin in the game so you start with VIP commands to use on yourself. You can buy stronger commands which you can use on other people or, all the players.

Join the group to get Mod commands! > https://www.roblox.com/groups/4566373/JozefDs-Group

Please leave a like on the game! 👍✔
